market.question: Will the highest temperature in Buenos Aires be 24°C on April 30?

assessment.reasoning: Forecast for Buenos Aires (Ezeiza) Apr 30 is high ~21°C, three degrees below the 24°C bucket. Late-April climatology averages ~20-21°C. Probability of a 3°C warm bust into 24°C is low.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Warm anomaly day is possible but not signaled in forecasts.
